ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Intelligent fire-control systems can calculate firing data automatically, but crew members still perform loading, emergency troubleshooting, and team coordination.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. military pay follows the Department of Defense rank and years-of-service system. Civilian BLS OES data does not cover military occupations, so this page does not provide a U.S. median. Salary references use Chinese mainland proxy data (Aiqicha and other public sources, sample of 10, 2026-08).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace artillery and missile crew members, but it will increase individual effectiveness. Intelligent fire control and guidance automate firing-data calculations, shifting crews from manual calculation and aiming toward coordination, emergency response, and safety. Purely mechanical operation faces the greatest pressure, while crew members who follow procedures under stress and handle emergencies become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Automatic calculation and entry of firing data
ai_s3_list: Battlefield coordination: human crews must work together.
Emergency response: people must clear jams and misfires.
Equipment judgment: people must assess anomalies.
Discipline: people must follow procedures.
Final accountability: people remain responsible for commands and actions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this career in a relatively low AI exposure zone. Loading, coordination, and emergency response are difficult to standardize, so near-term replacement risk is low, while fire-control automation increases individual effectiveness.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean no change. Calculation and aiming are being assisted, not coordination and response. Crew members who follow procedures under pressure and handle emergencies become scarcer as equipment advances.

ai_s5_persona.建议: First decide whether military service fits you. Physical readiness and discipline are fundamental. Pure operation is shrinking in the AI era, so develop coordination and emergency-response skills early.
Move beyond operating equipment to coordinating the crew and troubleshooting faults. Work toward becoming a gun commander or technical specialist.
Highlight discipline and teamwork, and specify your experience with operational equipment and missions. Civilian transitions often depend on transferable skills.
Evaluate coordination and execution. People who can maintain procedures and safety are strong candidates for management roles.

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent fire control and guidance increase individual effectiveness while reducing pure operator roles.
Coordination and emergency response become the core value.
Highly capable crew members who can handle emergencies become scarcer.

body: Artillery and missile crew members operate artillery and missile launch systems in military combat units. They load ammunition, enter firing data, aim and launch weapons, and provide coordinated support, turning fire orders into impacts at the operational level of the strike chain.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Intelligent fire-control systems can calculate firing data automatically, but crew members still perform loading, emergency troubleshooting, and team coordination.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 智能火控能自动解算诸元，但装填、应急排故和班协同，还得乘员上手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国军用薪酬由国防部等级制（军衔+年限）决定，民用 BLS OES 不统计军事职业，本页不提供美国中位数口径；薪资参考以中国大陆代理数据为准（爱企查等公开渠道，采样 10 条，2026-08）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代火炮与导弹乘员，但会提升单兵效能。智能火控与制导把诸元解算自动化，乘员从「手算手瞄」转向「管协同、处应急、保安全」。真正被挤掉的是纯机械操作，能在高压下按流程、能应急处置的乘员更值钱。
ai_s2_auto: 弹药装填的辅助机械化
ai_s3_list: 战场协同：班组配合靠人。
应急处置：卡弹哑火要人排。
装备判断：异常要人断。
纪律执行：流程靠人守。
责任兜底：口令与操作要人担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光区——装填、协同与应急处置难以标准化，短期替代风险小，但火控自动化在提升单兵效能。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但低曝光不等于没变化：被辅助的是「解算与瞄准」，不是「协同与处置」。能在高压下按流程、能应急的乘员，反而随装备升级更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 先想清从军意愿，体能和纪律是底线。AI 时代纯操作在缩，早点练协同与应急。
从「会操作」升级成「管协同 + 排故障」，争取转炮长或技术骨干。
突出纪律与团队协作，写清实装与任务经历。民用转岗多靠通用能力。
看协同与执行力，能扛流程和安全的人值得给管理岗。

ai_s7_trends: 智能火控与制导提升单兵效能，操作岗精简。
协同与应急处置成为核心价值。
高素养、能应急的乘员更稀缺。

body: 火炮与导弹乘员在军队作战单位操作火炮与导弹发射系统，完成弹药装填、诸元装定、瞄准发射与协同保障，是火力打击链条中把指令变成实弹落点的基层作战岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 智能火控能自动解算诸元，但装填、应急排故和班协同，还得乘员上手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated alignment can produce results, but scientists still decide which site is worth pursuing and how to explain the mechanism.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 63,700 bioinformatics scientists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 64,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 800 jobs, with approximately 4,800 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $93,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace bioinformatics scientists, but it will reduce standard workflow work. Automated alignment and AI annotation accelerate routine analysis, shifting scientists from running pipelines toward experimental design, mechanism interpretation, and multi-omics integration. People limited to standard pipelines face displacement, while those who design studies and explain results become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Experimental design: people define the question.
Mechanism interpretation: people explain the meaning.
Multi-omics integration: people identify relationships.
Reproducibility: people manage the code.
Research judgment: people set the direction.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 8/10, relatively high, means this occupation has high AI exposure in workflow tasks. Systems accelerate standard analysis, while study design and interpretation still leave an essential role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not equal high risk. Running standard pipelines faces replacement, not experimental-design roles. People who design studies and explain mechanisms become scarcer as efficiency rises, while bioinformatics workers limited to pipelines face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start in biology or computer science and practice programming. Pure pipeline work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop study-design skills early.
Advance from running pipelines to designing studies plus explaining mechanisms. Learn multi-omics integration and seek ownership of research projects.
Emphasize projects and reproducible code and identify the research topics you supported. Employers value reliability and domain understanding.
When hiring, look beyond scripts to study-design judgment. Core staff who explain mechanisms merit high compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Automated alignment becomes widespread and standard work shrinks.
Multi-omics integration creates opportunities.
Scientists who explain results well are in greater demand.

body: Bioinformatics Scientists use computational and statistical methods to analyze biological big data, perform sequence alignment, functional annotation, and modeling, and connect experimental biology with data science.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automated alignment can produce results, but scientists still decide which site is worth pursuing and how to explain the mechanism.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动比对能出结果，但哪个位点值得追、机制怎么讲，还是科学家定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年生物信息学科学家在岗约 6.37 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.45 万人，净增约 0.08 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.48 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.33 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代生信科学家，但会压缩标准流程。自动比对与 AI 注释把常规分析提速，科学家从「跑流程」挪向「实验设计、机制解释、跨组学整合」。真正被挤掉的是只跑标准流程的人，会解释能设计的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 实验设计：问题靠人定。
机制解释：意义靠人讲。
跨组学整合：关联靠人。
可复现：代码靠人管。
课题判断：方向靠人给。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 8/10 说明这个职业处在高 AI 曝光的流程区——标准分析被系统加速，但设计与解释还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「跑标准流程」动作，不是「实验设计」的岗位。会设计、能解释的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会跑流程的生信。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 生物/计算机起步多练编程，AI 时代纯流程在缩，早点练设计。
从「跑流程」升级成「做设计 + 讲机制」，学跨组学，争取课题。
突出项目与可复现代码，写清服务过哪些课题。用人方看重稳和懂。
选人别只看脚本，要看有没有设计脑子。能讲机制的骨干，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 自动比对普及，标准缩。
跨组学整合带来机会。
会解释的科学家更抢手。

body: 生物信息学科学家运用计算与统计方法分析生物大数据，做序列比对、功能注释与建模，连接实验生物学与数据科学。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动比对能出结果，但哪个位点值得追、机制怎么讲，还是科学家定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can interpret imagery and generate maps automatically, but a specialist who understands mapping standards must still decide when a feature is misclassified or terrain change is implausible.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 13,400 Cartographers And Photogrammetrists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 14,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 900 jobs, with approximately 1,000 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $78,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI is deeply reshaping cartography. Automated interpretation, feature extraction, and map generation reduce basic production time to a fraction of its former level, rapidly shrinking manual mapping roles. People still bear responsibility for map quality, surveying standards, data inspection, and three-dimensional modeling of complex scenes. Cartographers are shifting from drawing maps to managing data and controlling quality.
ai_s2_accel: Deep-learning detection of changes in ground features
ai_s2_auto: Automated image interpretation and feature extraction
ai_s3_list: Quality judgment: detect misclassified and omitted features
Surveying standards: apply map-symbol and accuracy requirements
Complex scenes: interpret obscured, mountainous, and other difficult areas
Data engineering: organize and inspect massive datasets
Field verification: apply experience from on-site measurement
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this GIS occupation in the moderate-high AI exposure tier. Image interpretation and map production are strong AI use cases, creating substantial replacement risk for pure production roles. Quality control, surveying standards, and data engineering still require specialists, shifting jobs toward higher-skill work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure requires a transition. Stop focusing on manual digitization and move into 3D modeling, data quality, GIS development, and project management. AI produces the map; you determine whether it is accurate and usable. Data quality remains scarce expertise.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study surveying engineering or GIS, and build skills in both remote-sensing interpretation and programming during university. Go beyond map drawing by joining surveying competitions and internships. Reality-based 3D and high-definition mapping are growing directions.

Move into data quality, 3D modeling, or GIS development, and pursue registered surveyor credentials. Treat AI tools as the production engine. Your value lies in managing data, controlling quality, and leading projects instead of tracing features by hand.

People with GIS or surveying foundations can transition by adding remote-sensing interpretation and 3D modeling, with emphasis on data-quality skills. Show finished maps in interviews and explain how you handled complex datasets.

Structure mapping teams around AI production plus human quality control. Assign basic map generation to AI and people to inspection and complex scenes, then redirect staff from repetitive work toward data engineering and 3D projects.

ai_s7_trends: Automated AI interpretation and map generation are spreading, reducing pure manual cartography roles.
Reality-based 3D China and high-definition mapping projects create demand for data processing.
Cartographers are moving toward data quality, 3D modeling, and GIS development.

body: Cartographers And Photogrammetrists use aerial and satellite imagery plus survey data to create maps and 3D models. They interpret imagery, map terrain, prepare thematic maps, and process spatial data that provides foundational geographic information for planning, navigation, and GIS.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can interpret imagery and generate maps automatically, but a specialist who understands mapping standards must still decide when a feature is misclassified or terrain change is implausible.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动解译影像、一键成图，但「这个要素归错类了、那片地形变化不合理」的质量判断，还得靠懂规范的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年制图师与摄影测量师在岗约 1.34 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.43 万人，净增约 0.09 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.10 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.84 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 正在深度改写制图业：自动解译、要素提取、全自动成图已经能把基础图生产的时间压缩到原来的零头，纯手工制图岗在快速收缩。但地图质量责任、测绘规范、数据质检和复杂场景的三维建模，仍需专业的人来把关——制图师会从「画图的人」变成「管数据、控质量的人」。
ai_s2_accel: 深度学习识别地物变化
ai_s2_auto: 影像自动解译与要素提取
ai_s3_list: 质量判断：错分、漏提要素的火眼金睛。
测绘规范：图式、精度标准的执行。
复杂场景：遮挡、山地等难解译区域。
数据工程：海量数据的组织与质检。
外业核查：现场实测的经验。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明制图是「中高曝光」的 GIS 职业：影像解译和成图正是 AI 最擅长的，纯制图操作岗替代风险大；但质量把关、测绘规范和数据工程仍需专业人才，岗位向高端转移。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光必须转型：别再练纯手工数字化，往三维建模、数据质检、GIS 开发和项目管理走。AI 出图，你负责「图对不对、能不能用」——数据质量是永远稀缺的岗位。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学测绘工程或 GIS 专业，大学期间把遥感解译和编程都练起来，别只会画图；多参加测绘技能竞赛和实习项目，实景三维和高精地图是风口方向。
往数据质检、三维建模和 GIS 开发转，考注册测绘师；把 AI 工具当生产引擎，你的价值在「管数据、控质量、带项目」而不是手工描图。
有 GIS 或测绘基础的可转岗：补遥感解译和三维建模，重点是数据质检能力；面试时展示你的成图作品，讲清楚你如何处理过复杂数据。
制图团队要「AI + 人工质检」分层：基础成图交给 AI，人工做质检和复杂场景，把人从重复劳动中解放出来，转去做数据工程和三维项目。

ai_s7_trends: AI 自动解译与成图普及，纯手工制图岗收缩。
实景三维中国与高精地图项目带来数据处理需求。
制图师转向数据质检、三维建模与 GIS 开发。

body: 制图师与摄影测量师利用航拍、卫星影像与测量数据编制地图和三维模型，负责影像解译、地形测图、专题制图与空间数据处理，为规划、导航与 GIS 提供基础地理信息。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动解译影像、一键成图，但「这个要素归错类了、那片地形变化不合理」的质量判断，还得靠懂规范的人。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can produce a compensation benchmark report within seconds, but people still decide what a job is worth and whether to approve the budget.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 107,000 Compensation, benefits, and job analysis specialists employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 112,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 5,700 jobs, with about 8,500 openings per year. The 2026 median annual wage is about $77,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI is taking over execution tasks for Compensation, benefits, and job analysis specialists. Compensation software and AI can perform market benchmarking, job matching, and report generation. The occupation will remain, but it will shift toward strategy and communication. AI calculates quickly, while people still decide the market percentile, balance the budget, and explain compensation decisions to employees.
ai_s3_list: Strategic judgment: choose the market percentile and balance fairness with cost.
Job evaluation: determine a job's actual value from its responsibilities.
Data analysis: identify the root causes of compensation problems in the data.
Persuasive communication: explain compensation logic to leaders and employees.
Compliance and confidentiality: take responsibility for sensitive data.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this HR data career in the moderate-high exposure range. Software replaces standardized benchmarking and reporting, increasing risk for execution-only roles. Compensation strategy, budget tradeoffs, and persuasive communication still depend on people. The occupation is shifting toward a model in which AI handles data and people make decisions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure creates an opportunity to move up the value chain. Learn to use AI and compensation software, then spend the saved time understanding the business and developing strategy. Specialists who progress from producing reports to defining strategy and explaining proposals become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: HR offers broad employment options, but do not stop at spreadsheet work. Study human resource management or labor economics and build strong data-analysis and labor-law skills. Starting as a compensation assistant can lead to compensation specialist or HRBP roles, which carry more value than purely administrative HR work.

Use compensation software and data-analysis tools instead of spending time on manual benchmarking. Build expertise in compensation strategy, equity incentives, and people analytics. Relevant HR certifications can strengthen the move from executor to specialist.

A background in data, finance, or statistics transfers well into compensation. Add an HR certification and compensation theory. In applications, highlight data-analysis projects such as market benchmarks or pay-adjustment proposals. Concrete cases are more persuasive than general HR experience.

Compensation roles combine data, strategy, and communication. Equip teams with a capable compensation system so people can focus on judgment. Create advancement paths into HRBP and compensation specialist roles. Retaining employees who understand data and communicate well costs less than repeated hiring.

ai_s7_trends: Software takes over compensation benchmarking and reporting, reducing execution roles.
Demand rises for people who combine strategy, data, and compliance.
Equity incentives and flexible benefits become new growth areas.

body: Compensation, benefits, and job analysis specialists design and maintain organizational compensation and benefits systems. Their work includes compensation surveys and benchmarking, job analysis and value evaluation, pay and benefits plan design, compensation data analysis, and compliance management.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can produce a compensation benchmark report within seconds, but people still decide what a job is worth and whether to approve the budget.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能秒出薪酬对标报告，但「这个岗位到底值多少钱、这笔预算该不该批」——薪酬的判断和担当，还得人拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年薪酬、福利与岗位分析专员在岗约 10.70 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 11.27 万人，净增约 0.57 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.85 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.70 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 正在接管薪酬专员的执行环节：市场对标、岗位匹配、报告生成都能被薪酬软件和 AI 完成。岗位不会消失，但会向「策略与沟通」转型——AI 算得快，但薪酬策略定在哪个分位、预算怎么平衡、怎么跟员工解释，这些决策和沟通依然靠人。
ai_s2_accel: 合规审查 AI 辅助
ai_s2_auto: 薪酬对标数据自动获取
ai_s3_list: 策略判断：定在哪个分位、怎么平衡公平与成本。
岗位评估：从职责描述判断岗位真实价值。
数据分析：从数据里读薪酬问题的根因。
沟通说服：把薪酬逻辑讲给管理层和员工听。
合规与保密：敏感数据的责任担当。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明薪酬专员是「中高曝光」的 HR 数据岗：对标、报告等标准执行被软件替代，纯执行型岗位风险上升；但薪酬策略、预算平衡和沟通说服依赖人，属于「AI 做数据，人做决策」的转型期岗位。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光是转型契机：把 AI 和薪酬软件用熟，把省下的时间花在业务理解和策略思考上，从「会出报告」升级为「会定策略、会讲方案」，价值反而更高。

ai_s5_persona.建议: HR 是就业面很宽的行业，但别停在「做表格」：建议孩子学人力资源管理或劳动经济学，把数据分析、劳动法知识打牢，从薪酬助理做起，往薪酬专家、HRBP 方向走，比纯事务型 HR 值钱得多。
把薪酬软件和数据分析工具用起来，别耗在手工对标上；往薪酬策略、股权激励、人力数据分析方向深耕，考人力资源管理师等证书，从「执行」转「专家」。
有数据、财务、统计背景的转薪酬有优势：先考 HR 证书、补薪酬理论，求职时突出数据分析案例（做过薪酬对标、写过调薪方案都算），比单讲 HR 经验更打动面试官。
薪酬岗位核心是「数据 + 策略 + 沟通」三合一：建议配好薪酬系统，让人做判断；给专员提供 HRBP、薪酬专家等晋升通道，留住懂数据又会沟通的人，比反复招人划算。

ai_s7_trends: 薪酬对标与报告全面软件化，执行岗收缩。
策略、数据、合规复合型人才更抢手。
股权激励与弹性福利成为新方向。

body: 薪酬、福利与岗位分析专员负责设计与维护企业的薪酬与福利体系，包括薪酬调研与对标、岗位分析与价值评估、薪资福利方案设计、薪酬数据分析与合规管理。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能秒出薪酬对标报告，但「这个岗位到底值多少钱、这笔预算该不该批」——薪酬的判断和担当，还得人拍板。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Precut ingredients and smart cooking equipment can replace basic tasks, but cooks still control heat and decide the final flavor.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,460,200 Cooks, Restaurant were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 1,677,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 217,000 jobs. The occupation generates about 250,700 openings per year and had a median annual wage of about $36,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Cooks, Restaurant, but it will reduce standardized cooking work. Prepared foods and smart kitchen equipment speed up routine service, shifting cooks from producing standard dishes toward heat control, flavor innovation, and consistent quality. Roles limited to standard preparation face the most pressure, while cooks with taste and creativity are more resilient.
ai_s3_list: Heat control: people manage the stove.
Flavor innovation: people adjust the taste.
Consistent output: people maintain the standard.
Peak-period coordination: people make tradeoffs.
Apprenticeship: people pass on the craft.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate exposure. Systems speed up parts of the work, while people retain the tasks that require judgment and accountability.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces the act of cooking standard dishes, not the roles responsible for heat and flavor. Cooks with taste and creativity become scarcer as efficiency improves. Workers limited to standardized prepared food face the most pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: At the start of culinary training, practice heat control and flavor. Standardized work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop creativity early.
Move from cooking standard dishes toward flavor and innovation, while learning cost and quality control.
Emphasize consistent quality and speed. Restaurants value reliability and efficiency.
Do not hire only for speed; evaluate palate and creativity. Strong cooks deserve responsibility for a station.

ai_s7_trends: Prepared foods spread, reducing standardized roles.
Heat control and innovation create opportunities.
Cooks with a strong palate are more resilient.

body: Cooks, Restaurant prepare and plate dishes, coordinating ingredients, heat, and seasoning. They combine culinary skill with teamwork to deliver consistently service-ready food.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 净菜与智能锅能替基础，但火候怎么控、味怎么定，还是厨师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年餐馆厨师在岗约 146.02 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 167.72 万人，净增约 21.70 万个岗位，年均产生约 25.07 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.68 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代餐馆厨师，但会压缩标准烹饪。预制菜与智能厨具把常规出餐提速，厨师从「炒标准菜」挪向「火候把控、口味创新、出品稳定」。真正被挤掉的是纯标准岗，懂味、能创新的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 火候把控：灶靠人控。
口味创新：味靠人调。
出品稳定：标准靠人。
高峰调度：取舍靠人。
师徒传授：手艺靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——部分环节被系统加速，但真正要人判断与兜底的地方还留着位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「炒标准菜」动作，不是「火候与口味」的岗位。懂味、能创新的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做标准预制。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 厨艺起步多练火候和味，AI 时代纯标准在缩，早点练创新。
从「炒标准」升级成「口味 + 创新」，学成本与出品。
突出稳定出品与速度，餐厅看重稳和快。
选人别只看快，看味感和创新，骨干值得给档口。

ai_s7_trends: 预制普及，标准缩。
火候创新带来机会。
懂味的厨师更稳。

body: 餐馆厨师主导菜品的烹饪与出品，统筹备料、火候与调味，运用厨艺与协作手段，做出稳定可上的菜落地。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can search in three seconds through archives that would take you three months to review, but a curator still has to decide why the objects belong together and how to keep them from deteriorating.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reports that about 15,100 Curators were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 16,200 by 2034, a net gain of about 1,100 jobs, with roughly 1,800 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $61,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace curators, but it will reshape the desk-based side of curatorial work. AI can accelerate collection searches, background research, first drafts of labels, and even collection-record organization, freeing curators to define narratives, make choices, secure resources, and inspect storage areas. The truly scarce ability is turning a group of objects into a memorable story while keeping them safe.
ai_s2_accel: AI image recognition for attribution assistance and matching similar objects
Data-informed design of visitor flow and interactive installations
Rapid creation of virtual exhibitions and online galleries
Intelligent analysis of collection-environment monitoring data
ai_s2_auto: Structured entry of collection catalogs and archival data
Initial screening of literature searches and provenance research
Initial drafts of exhibition labels and catalog text
Automation of scheduling, shipping, customs, and other process documents
ai_s3_list: Theme and narrative judgment: AI cannot take a position on what deserves display or why it matters.
Aesthetic and spatial judgment: training builds the instinct for wall placement, height, and lighting.
Resource coordination and professional networks: loans depend on relationships and sponsorships depend on negotiation.
Academic integrity and provenance review: curators remain accountable for provenance, while AI only offers leads.
Collection conservation judgment: take responsibility for decisions about temperature, humidity, lighting, and restoration plans.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score means that a substantial share of this occupation involves desk work, such as cataloging, searching, writing, and records management, precisely the areas where AI performs best.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: But moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk: as searching and drafting become cheaper, topic selection and narrative become more valuable. Execution-focused curators who can only organize information without making judgments face pressure, while curators who can tell stories and understand collection conservation become more sought after.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Alongside art history, museum studies, or archaeology, build foundations in digital humanities, data analysis, and collection conservation. In the AI era, curators who can research, use technology, and care for collections are scarcer, and internships matter more than grades.

Use AI search, image recognition, and digital-curation tools to free time for theme development and resource building. Create cross-disciplinary and digital exhibitions; the portfolio is the strongest credential.

Do not just write that you love art; present a complete exhibition proposal or a show you helped deliver. The ability to write labels, build a budget, understand exhibition installation, and handle basic collection care will impress employers more than passion alone.

When hiring curators, look beyond degrees and ask what exhibitions candidates have completed independently. Candidates who use AI efficiently while upholding academic standards and sound collection-safety judgment deserve greater resources.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Cross-database search and initial provenance screening
Real-time temperature, humidity, and light monitoring

ai_s7_trends: Digital curation and online galleries shift from optional additions to standard practice, combining physical exhibitions with digital narratives.
AI search and generation lower the entry threshold, making creative content and resource coordination the core barriers.
Demand grows for commercial curation and cross-disciplinary exhibitions, while curatorial thinking spreads into more industries.

body: Curators research, manage, and present permanent collections or borrowed objects; plan exhibition themes and narratives; coordinate transportation, installation, labels, and public education; manage collection records; and coordinate conservation and restoration. They connect collections.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can search in three seconds through archives that would take you three months to review, but a curator still has to decide why the objects belong together and how to keep them from deteriorating.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能在三秒钟里查完你三个月要翻的档案，但「为什么把它们摆在一起、怎么保它不坏」，还得策展人拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年策展人在岗约 1.51 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.62 万人，净增约 0.11 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.18 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.18 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代策展人，但会重构策展的案头部分。藏品检索、资料考证、展牌初稿、甚至藏品档案整理都能交给 AI 提速，策展人的时间从「翻档案」挪向「定叙事、做取舍、谈资源、看库房」。真正稀缺的，是把一堆物件讲成一个让人记住的故事，同时管好它们不坏的能力。
ai_s2_accel: AI 图像识别辅助鉴定与相似藏品匹配
观众动线与互动装置的数据化设计
虚拟展览与线上展厅的快速搭建
藏品环境监测数据的智能分析
ai_s2_auto: 藏品编目与档案数据的结构化录入
文献检索与来源考证的初筛
展牌文案与图录文字的初稿生成
展览排期、运输报关等流程文件的自动化
ai_s3_list: 选题立意与叙事判断：什么值得展、怎么讲才有价值，AI 给不了立场。
审美与空间感觉：一件展品放哪面墙、多高、什么光，是长期训练出来的直觉。
资源协调与人情网络：借展靠关系、赞助靠谈判，机器递不出名片。
学术诚信与来源审查：藏品的 provenance 审查要担责任，AI 只能给线索。
藏品保护判断：温湿度、光照、修复方案的取舍，要对物件负责。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业有相当一部分工作在案头——编目、检索、文案、档案，这些恰恰是 AI 最擅长的领域。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：检索和初稿越便宜，选题和叙事越值钱。被挤压的是只会整理资料、不会做判断的「执行型策展」，会讲故事、又懂藏品保护的策展人反而更抢手。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学艺术史、博物馆学、考古的同时，把数字人文、数据分析和藏品保护基础补上。AI 时代「会考据 + 懂技术 + 懂保管」的策展人更稀缺，实习比成绩更值钱。
把 AI 检索、图像识别、数字策展工具用起来，把时间从案头解放出来投到选题和资源上。多做跨界展和数字展，作品集才是硬通货。
别只写「热爱艺术」，要拿出一个完整策展方案或参与过的展览案例。会写展牌、会做预算表、懂点布展施工和藏品保管，比情怀更容易打动招聘方。
招策展人别只看学历，要看「独立完成过什么展」。能用 AI 提效、又守得住学术底线和藏品安全判断的候选人，值得给更多资源。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 相似藏品匹配、真伪线索
多方案摆位预演、方案对比

ai_s7_trends: 数字策展与线上展厅从补充变成标配，实体展 + 数字叙事双线并行。
AI 检索与生成让策展门槛下移，内容创意与资源整合成为核心壁垒。
商业策展、跨界展览需求增长，「策展思维」外溢到更多行业。

body: 策展人负责研究、管理和呈现馆藏或借展品，策划展览主题与叙事，协调展品运输、布展、展牌与公共教育活动，同时管理藏品档案并协调保存修复工作，是连接藏品。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能在三秒钟里查完你三个月要翻的档案，但「为什么把它们摆在一起、怎么保它不坏」，还得策展人拍板。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Self-diagnostic systems can report a fault code, but people still find the cold solder joint, determine how to disassemble the unit, and take the measurements.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 7,000 transportation equipment electrical repairers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 7,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 400 jobs, with about 600 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $82,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace transportation equipment electrical repairers, but it will accelerate diagnosis. Self-diagnostics and fault databases speed up routine fault location, shifting work from part replacement toward schematic-based troubleshooting and system commissioning. Workers limited to swapping parts face pressure; those who diagnose and commission systems gain value.
ai_s3_list: People handle complex troubleshooting.
People commission systems.
People make on-site judgments.
People provide the hands-on skill for disassembly and installation.
People make the final safety release decision.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means moderate AI exposure. Diagnostic systems accelerate fault location, but disassembly, commissioning, and professional judgment still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high job risk. Systems replace routine part-swapping tasks, not system-commissioning roles. Workers who read schematics and resolve complex faults become scarcer as diagnostic tools spread; workers who only replace the part named by a code face the most pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build from mechatronics fundamentals and practice schematic reading and diagnosis. Routine part replacement is shrinking, so learn the complete system early.
Progress from part replacement to troubleshooting and commissioning. Learn self-diagnostic tools and fault databases.
Highlight the vehicle types you have serviced and the credentials you hold. Maintenance employers value accuracy and reliability.
Do not hire only for speed. Test schematic-reading ability, and pay a premium for technicians who can troubleshoot independently.

ai_s7_trends: Self-diagnostics reduce routine part-replacement work.
System commissioning becomes more valuable.
Multiple vehicle types still require human technicians.

body: Electrical And Electronics Installers And Repairers, Transportation Equipment install, commission, and repair electrical and electronic systems in aircraft, rail vehicles, ships, and other transportation equipment. They locate and restore wiring and module faults.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Self-diagnostic systems can report a fault code, but people still find the cold solder joint, determine how to disassemble the unit, and take the measurements.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自诊断能报故障码，但哪根线虚焊、怎么拆、怎么测，还是人上手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年运输修理在岗约 0.70 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.74 万人，净增约 0.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.06 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.27 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代电气维修工，但会加速诊断。自诊断与数据库把常规故障定位提速，员工从「换件」挪向「读图排复杂故障、系统调试」。真正被挤掉的是纯换件，会诊断能调试的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 复杂排故靠人。
系统调试靠人。
现场判断靠人。
拆装手感靠人。
安全放行靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的维修区——诊断被系统加速，但拆装与判断还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「换件」动作，不是「系统调试」的岗位。会读图、能排复杂故障的人，反而随诊断普及更稀缺。怕的是只会按码换件的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 机电起步多练读图和诊断，纯换件在缩，早点学系统。
从「换件」升级成「排故 + 调试」，学自诊断与数据库。
突出跟过的车型和证书，机务看重稳和准。
选人别只看手快，要看读图功底。能排故的骨干值得给高补贴。

ai_s7_trends: 自诊断吃换件。
系统调试更值钱。
多车型仍要人。

body: 运输设备电气电子安装维修工安装、调试与检修飞机、机车、船舶等运输设备的电气电子系统，定位并恢复线路与模块故障。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自诊断能报故障码，但哪根线虚焊、怎么拆、怎么测，还是人上手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can outline a semester of course materials in ten minutes, but it cannot read the look in a student's eyes during class.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 3,200 Family And Consumer Sciences Teachers, Postsecondary were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 3,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 100 jobs, with about 200 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $77,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Family And Consumer Sciences Teachers, Postsecondary, but it will change the efficiency of lesson preparation and research. AI can draft slides, handouts, and literature reviews. Teachers can redirect that time toward classroom interaction, practical guidance, and academic judgment. Their presence in class, real-time project coaching, and individual attention to students remain difficult to replace.
ai_s2_accel: AI learning analytics that track student mastery
AI-assisted teaching evaluation and improvement suggestions
ai_s2_auto: Automatic drafting of slides and course handouts
Digital assignment grading and grade entry
Management of course materials and question banks
ai_s3_list: Classroom presence and pacing: present the same material in a way that holds students' attention.
Real-time practical guidance: identify the right prompt when a student project stalls.
Academic judgment and research review: decide which questions merit study and which conclusions hold up.
Teacher-student relationships and educational responsibility: influence student choices over time.
Curriculum design: organize fragmented knowledge into a coherent professional program.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate AI exposure. A large share of the role involves desk work such as lesson planning, literature review, and grading, where AI can raise efficiency.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high replacement risk. As desk work becomes lighter, teaching and research quality matter more. Pressure falls on teachers who lecture directly from old slides, while teachers who engage students gain stability.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study family and consumer sciences, food and nutrition, or education, and decide early whether to emphasize teaching or research. A master's degree is the usual foundation and a doctorate adds value. Teaching-assistant experience during graduate school often aligns more closely with hiring needs than publications alone.

Use AI tools for lesson preparation and research, then invest the saved time in course innovation and student guidance. Build a distinct focus in life-skills education or community practice instead of relying on traditional handouts.

Postsecondary teaching roles evaluate education and teaching work together. Prepare a sample lecture video and course outline. Community and adult education also use similar skills, so do not limit the search to permanent university appointments.

Require a teaching demonstration instead of judging candidates only by publications. Candidates who teach engagingly, guide practical projects, and use AI efficiently bring more value than those focused only on publication volume.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Initial drafts of outlines, handouts, and PPT slides
Household scenario simulations and case analysis

ai_s7_trends: Digital and online teaching are becoming standard, making blended classrooms routine.
Interest is rising in life-skills education, household finance, and healthy living, renewing attention to the field.
AI is raising teaching and research efficiency, while faculty evaluation shifts from volume toward quality.

body: Family And Consumer Sciences Teachers, Postsecondary teach related courses in higher education, guide student practice and research, and study teaching methods. They provide professional education in household management, nutrition, and consumer education.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can outline a semester of course materials in ten minutes, but it cannot read the look in a student's eyes during class.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 十分钟能排出一学期课件，但课堂上一个学生的眼神，AI 捕捉不到。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年教师、高等教育在岗约 0.32 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.33 万人，净增约 0.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.02 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.73 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校家政教师，但会改写备课和研究的效率。课件、讲义、文献综述都能让 AI 打底，教师的时间转向课堂互动、实践指导和学术判断。真正难以替代的，是讲台上的感染力、带项目时的临场引导，以及对学生的个体关注。
ai_s2_accel: AI 学习分析追踪学生掌握度
虚拟仿真实践项目的搭建
AI 辅助教学评估与改进建议
ai_s2_auto: 课件与讲义初稿的自动生成
作业批改与成绩录入的电子化
课程资料与题库的管理
ai_s3_list: 课堂感染力与教学节奏：同样的内容，怎么讲学生才爱听。
实践指导的临场判断：学生项目卡住了，怎么点拨。
学术判断与科研把关：什么课题值得做、什么结论站得住。
师生关系与育人责任：影响一个学生的选择，是长期的事。
课程体系设计的整体眼光：把碎片知识组织成有逻辑的专业培养。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半工作在案头——备课、文献、批改，这些正是 AI 最擅长的提效区。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：案头越轻，教学与研究质量越成为核心指标。被挤压的是照本宣科、课件十年不更新的教师，会互动的教师地位更稳。

高校教学岗看「学历 + 教学作品」：准备一份试讲视频和课程大纲。社区教育、成人教育机构也是同类技能的出口，别只盯着编制。
招教学岗要试讲而非只看论文。能讲得生动、带得了实践项目、又能用 AI 提效的候选人，比只会灌水的更值钱。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: A drone flight can replace three days of conventional fieldwork, but surveyors still decide where denser measurements are needed and which datasets cannot be trusted.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 56,100 workers in 2024, projected to rise to 58,600 by 2034. That is a net gain of about 2,500 jobs, with roughly 3,900 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $72,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not eliminate surveying, but it is changing how surveyors work. Drone photogrammetry, satellite positioning, automated point-cloud classification, and AI-assisted adjustment have made much field collection and office computation semi-automated. Roles centered on total stations and manual records are shrinking, while surveyors who operate modern equipment, judge data quality, and present results are more valuable because they deliver greater productivity.
ai_s2_accel: Rapid terrain capture with drone photogrammetry
Satellite positioning and continuously operating reference stations
ai_s2_auto: Automated coordinate calculation and projection conversion
ai_s3_list: Control network design: coordinate site selection, network layout, and accuracy estimates.
Data quality judgment: identify out-of-tolerance points and decide which measurements require repetition.
Field point selection: balance visibility, stability, and accessibility.
Result interpretation: turn coordinate data into conclusions engineers can use.
Field adaptability: devise temporary solutions for difficult terrain and weather.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 score places this occupation in a moderate-high AI exposure range. The surveying data pipeline is already highly automated, with AI and machinery accelerating each step from collection to mapping. Traditional operator roles are losing prominence, but field conditions and unstructured judgment remain difficult. That is why it scores 7 rather than 9.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure is not necessarily bad news. New technology can multiply productivity in surveying, and people who learn drones and point-cloud processing quickly move from collecting points to managing projects. Stronger tools increase the value of skilled operators.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Choose surveying and mapping engineering, and develop skills in drones, 3D laser scanning, and programming with Python or CAD. Traditional surveying courses provide the foundation, but not the whole skill set. Field resilience is essential, while modern technical ability determines advancement.

Learn drone photogrammetry and point-cloud processing quickly, then progress from field data collector to an integrated field-and-office specialist. Pursue professional surveying credentials because project leadership generally pays more than fieldwork alone.

People with civil engineering or GIS backgrounds can transition smoothly. In interviews, emphasize modern equipment and software rather than only traditional total stations. Willingness to travel and work outdoors remains fundamental.

Traditional field operators are easy to recruit, while multidisciplinary surveyors are scarce. Provide internal training that moves field staff into drone photogrammetry, and offer sufficient allowances for overseas and remote projects to retain people with modern skills.

ai_s7_trends: Drones and LiDAR are becoming standard surveying tools and greatly reducing fieldwork.
AI-based adjustment and feature recognition increase office productivity and digitize deliverables.
Multidisciplinary surveyors who can fly, compute, and communicate are replacing pure field operators.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光对你未必是坏事：测量是「会了新技术就产能翻倍」的行业，主动学无人机和点云处理的人，很快就从「测点的」变成「管项目的」。工具越强，会用工具的人越值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选测绘工程专业，一定要把无人机、三维激光、编程（Python/CAD）学好，纯传统测量课程是地基不是全部；这行能吃苦是前提，但会新技术才是上限。
尽快上手无人机航测和点云处理，把「外业采集员」升级成「内外业一体化」的复合人才；考注册测绘师，带项目比纯跑野外收入高一个台阶。
有土木、GIS 背景的人转测量最顺；面试时突出会用的设备和新软件，别只讲传统全站仪；能接受出差和野外作业是基本盘。
传统作业员好招、复合型测量人才难找，建议内部做「外业转无人机航测」培训；把出海和偏远项目补贴给足，留住会新技术的人。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 整线能自动灌装，但换模和异常处置，还是操作工定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器操作员看护员在岗约 38.12 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 39.82 万人，净增约 1.70 万个岗位，年均产生约 4.53 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.09 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代操作工，但会压缩标准值守。整线自动化把常规灌装提速，操作工从「盯线」挪向「调机、换模、处置」。真正被挤掉的是只抄表的，有调机力能处置的更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 调机力：参数靠人调。
换模力：规格靠人换。
异常处置：故障靠人修。
巡检力：状态靠人看。
稳定产出：线靠人稳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的产线区——灌装被加速，但调机还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「盯标准线」动作，不是「调机处置」的岗位。有调机力、能处置的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会看屏的操作工。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 机电起步多练调机和换模，AI 时代纯值守在缩，早点练处置。
从「盯线」升级成「调机 + 换模」，学设备数据。
突出机台和证书，写清跟过哪些产线。工厂看重稳和准。
选人别只看体力，要看有没有调机脑子。能处置的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 整线自动化普及
标准岗缩
有调机力更抢手

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Remote sensing can measure vegetation cover, but managers still decide how to conduct field surveys and coordinate interests.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 28,500 range managers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 29,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,000 jobs, with about 2,500 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $67,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace range managers, but it will reduce field-survey work. Remote sensing and models automate vegetation monitoring, shifting managers from counting grass to coordination, restoration decisions, and sustainable planning. Pure data collection is most vulnerable, while people who coordinate and decide become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Remote sensing estimates of vegetation cover
ai_s3_list: Field surveys: people provide visual judgment.
Stakeholder coordination: people negotiate.
Restoration decisions: people make tradeoffs.
Long-term planning: people define values.
Enforcement communication: people communicate with people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 means this occupation has moderately high exposure. Systems accelerate monitoring, but people retain their role in coordination and decisions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean no change. Data collection is being replaced, not coordination and decision-making. Managers who coordinate and design plans become scarcer as efficiency improves. Those who only sample face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start in grassland science or ecology and gain extensive field experience. Pure data collection is shrinking in the AI era, so practice coordination early.
Advance from sampling to managing coordination + designing plans, and learn remote sensing and modeling.
Highlight field and coordination cases and specify the rangelands you managed.
When hiring, look beyond education to coordination ability. Core professionals who design plans are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Remote sensing spreads and field surveys decline.
Grass-livestock balance receives greater emphasis.
Managers who coordinate effectively are more sought after.

body: Range managers oversee rangeland and pasture resources, assess vegetation and hydrology, develop rotational grazing and restoration plans, coordinate land users, and prevent fires and erosion to ensure sustainable resource use.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 遥感能看盖度，但实地踏查和利益协调，还是经理定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年牧场资源经理在岗约 2.85 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.95 万人，净增约 0.10 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.25 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.79 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代牧场资源经理，但会压缩踏查。遥感与模型把植被监测自动化，经理从「数草」挪向「协调、修复决策、可持续规划」。真正被替的是只采数的，能协调能决策的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 实地踏查：眼判靠人。
利益协调：谈判靠人。
修复决策：取舍靠人。
长期规划：价值靠人。
执法沟通：人传人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——监测被系统加速，但协调与决策还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：被替代的是「采数」动作，不是「协调决策」的岗位。能协调、能定方案的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会取样。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 草业/生态起步多跑野外，AI 时代纯采数在缩，早点练协调。
从「采样」升级成「管协调 + 定方案」，学遥感与模型。
突出野外与协调案例，写清管过哪些草场。
选人别只看学历，要看能不能协调。能定方案的骨干值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 遥感普及，踏查减。
草畜平衡受重视。
能协调的经理更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Hoisting assistance can help with alignment, but structural iron and steel workers still decide which beam goes up first, how to secure it, and when high winds require work to stop.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 65,700 workers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 68,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,900 jobs, with about 5,500 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $62,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace structural iron and steel workers, and this is among the hardest occupations to automate. Hoisting assistance and layout software accelerate routine actions, but alignment at height, fastening, and on-site safety judgment still rely on people. Pure manual handling faces displacement, while workers with blueprint-reading skills and strong safety judgment are more secure.
ai_s3_list: Alignment at height: tactile judgment relies on people.
Fastening judgment: people ensure secure connections.
Blueprint reading and layout: people manage errors.
Safety judgment: people assess risks.
On-site coordination: signals rely on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this occupation in a low AI-exposure area of physical on-site work. Systems only provide assistance, while people still perform the core work at height.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low risk does not mean no change. Layout and recordkeeping become more efficient, but alignment and fastening at height do not disappear. People with blueprint-reading skills and strong safety judgment become more valuable as prefabricated construction expands. Those who rely only on brute-force handling face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin in construction and practice blueprint reading and safety. Pure material handling is shrinking in the AI era, so develop technical skills early.
Advance from carrying and fastening to blueprint reading plus signal coordination. Learn hoisting-assistance systems and seek a crew leadership role.
Highlight work-at-height and project experience and specify the structures you have worked on. Construction employers value steadiness and willingness to work at height.
When hiring, look beyond strength to safety judgment. Core workers who can lead a crew deserve high daily rates.

ai_s7_trends: Prefabrication raises productivity in routine roles.
People still perform alignment and fastening at height.
Technical workers who can read drawings are in greater demand.

body: Structural iron and steel workers hoist, align, and fasten structural steel components. They coordinate beams, columns, bolts, and signals and use blueprint-reading and work-at-height judgment to assemble structural frames.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Hoisting assistance can help with alignment, but structural iron and steel workers still decide which beam goes up first, how to secure it, and when high winds require work to stop.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 吊装辅助能帮忙对位，但哪根梁先上、怎么锁死、风大怎么停，还是钢结构工定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工人在岗约 6.57 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.86 万人，净增约 0.29 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.55 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.27 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代钢结构安装工，也最难被替代。吊装辅助与放线软件提速常规动作，但高空对位、锁紧和现场安全判断仍靠人。被挤掉的是纯体力搬运，有读图和安全脑子的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 高空对位：手感靠人。
锁紧判断：牢靠靠人。
读图放样：误差靠人。
安全判断：风险靠人。
现场协同：信号靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光的体力现场区——系统只帮辅助，核心高空活还在人手里。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低风险不等于没变化：被提效的是放线和记录，不是高空对位与锁紧。有读图和安全脑子的人，反而随装配化更吃香。怕的是只会蛮力搬运的。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 建筑起步多练读图和安全，AI 时代纯搬运在缩，早点练技术。
从「搬和锁」升级成「读图 + 带信号」，学吊装辅助，争取班组。
突出高空和项目经验，写清跟过哪些结构。工地看重稳和敢上。
选人别只看力气，要看有没有安全脑子。能带班的骨干，值得给高日薪。

ai_s7_trends: 装配式提速，常规岗提效。
高空与锁紧仍要人。
有技术读图手更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can absorb much of the repetitive, structurable work of Surveying And Mapping Technicians, but judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination still rest with people. What actually gets squeezed out is pure execution.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 59,400 surveying and mapping technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 62,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,700 jobs, with about 7,600 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $51,900 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace surveying and mapping technicians, but it will reshape their workflows. Tools will handle repetitive and structured tasks, while people focus on judgment, accountability, and creativity. Routine, scripted execution faces displacement, while people who can apply expertise to real settings and make decisions become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use data profiles to accelerate assessment of clients or learners in surveying and mapping technician work.
Use simulations and scenario exercises to accelerate planning for surveying and mapping technician work.
Use retrieval tools to accelerate verification of surveying and mapping materials and regulations.
Use collaboration tools to accelerate cross-team coordination in surveying and mapping technician work.
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate structured documents and reports related to surveying and mapping technician work.
Process and classify repetitive data for surveying and mapping technicians.
Perform rules-based preliminary screening and scheduling for surveying and mapping technician work.
Search surveying and mapping technician knowledge bases and extract key points.
ai_s3_list: Professional judgment and tradeoff analysis in real surveying and mapping settings.
The ability to explain surveying and mapping expertise to nonexperts.
Accountability and final review in surveying and mapping work.
Cross-boundary resource integration and interpersonal coordination in surveying and mapping work.
Applying tacit knowledge gained through long-term surveying and mapping experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: Scoring rationale: AI can assist surveying and mapping technicians, but professional judgment and final accountability are difficult to replace, resulting in an exposure score of 7/10.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Turn 7/10 into an advantage: let AI take the repetitive work, and spend your time on real projects, judgment, and people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: First build a strong foundation in surveying and mapping and accumulate experience on real projects.
Connect your existing experience with surveying and mapping work and identify a differentiated entry point.
Turn surveying and mapping experience into products or management capabilities to increase leverage.
Use AI to reduce repetitive surveying and mapping work and focus on decisions.

ai_s7_trends: First, collaboration between surveying and mapping technicians and AI becomes standard, making tool proficiency a basic requirement.
Second, high-value judgment and accountability in surveying and mapping become scarcer.
Third, surveying and mapping roles evolve toward a combination of professional expertise plus management or product capabilities.
